prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1098; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was driving on a two-lane road in the early afternoon. Traffic was light. The other vehicle came over the center line and we ended up nose to nose. I braked hard but there wasn't time to avoid it. It did not feel like a high-speed impact.

Q: How fast do you believe you were traveling before the collision?

A: Maybe twenty-five miles an hour, something like that. I wasn't in a hurry.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did either airbag deploy?

A: No, they didn't. My car was drivable at first, but I had it towed because the front end was pushed in.

Q: Where do you feel injuries right now?

A: My right shoulder hurts a lot. I hit the steering wheel and the seatbelt grabbed me across the chest. The shoulder pain started within an hour and has been getting worse when I lift anything.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same evening. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic provider.

Q: Did you have any shoulder problems before this collision?

A: No, not that I can recall. I was working out regularly and had no restrictions.

Q: Is there anything else you want to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll send over any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
